title: Is Chris Evans Returning As Captain America In Avengers: Doomsday Gets A Definitive Answer
summary: The MCU confirms Steve Rogers will appear in Avengers: Doomsday and Anthony Mackie clarified Rogers' trajectory, noting comic-book precedent where Rogers becomes Nomad. Chris Evans returns in the film and is also set to appear in Avengers: Secret Wars (2027). The crossover will reunite many legacy characters from Fantastic Four, X-Men, and the Thunderbolts, with surprises still promised.
content:
The Marvel Cinematic Universe is finally clearing things up on an original Avenger's return later this year.

The MCU timeline is getting closer to seeing Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom take on Earth's Mightiest Heroes, as the Iron Man star is coming back, but as the famous foe. However, as the franchise tackles the last chapter of their multiverse adventures, the superhero team will be reunited with some old friends this fall.

In an interview with Variety, Anthony Mackie cleared things up about Steve Rogers' appearance in Avengers: Doomsday, which had a big presence at San Diego Comic-Con 2026, and whether or not the MCU veteran is back as Captain America. Mackie, who plays Sam Wilson, a.k.a. the new Captain America, stated, "No - Steve Rogers in the comic book — There is a comic book. You say you're a nerd. Read the comic book. Don't be a nerd by trade, be a nerd by fact. So, in the comic book, Steve Rogers becomes Nomad."

The Avengers: Doomsday trailer that was released earlier this week gave a closer look at Evans' 2026 return, showing him reunited with Chris Hemsworth's Thor. However, the upcoming December feature won't be the last time the audience sees Steve in the MCU.

The Captain America star has also confirmed that he will be in Joe and Anthony Russo's Avengers: Secret Wars in 2027, with principal photography set to start this summer. As of writing, no details have been shared on his involvement in the Phase 6 finale.

Despite finishing his time as the First Avenger in 2019's Avengers: Endgame, Evans waited nearly half a decade before making his way back to the MCU, but with a catch. While appearing in 2024's Deadpool & Wolverine, he reprised his role as Johnny Storm, a.k.a. the Human Torch, from Fox's Fantastic Four films from the 2000s.

At CinemaCon 2026, Evans broke his silence about being part of the Avengers: Doomsday cast, stressing that "I said I would only come back if there was a real reason, and in Doomsday, there's a very real reason why these heroes need Steve Rogers," before making a quippy response about how he "don't like" Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. However, the former Captain America isn't the only big return in the massive team-up film.

Not only will the MCU's Fantastic Four finally cross paths with the Avengers, but several iconic mutants from Fox's X-Men films are set to return, with multiple actors reprising their roles. The Thunderbolts (a.k.a. the New Avengers) will also come together with the other heroes. However, Kevin Feige has previously stated that there are still many surprises left in store for audience members in terms of who else might be appearing in the movie.

Avengers: Doomsday opens in theaters on December 18.
